text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of summer camp,
and King
Halo has the Kikuka Sho on her
mind.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Who will seize glorious victory in the
Kikuka Sho?
What's her name?

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Followers
text_block_list.text: King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! You couldn't be more correct!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, you dummy! This is the part
where
you're supposed to say "King is
the best!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
For the time being, training is secondary!
Now is
the moment for making grand
impressions!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
With the amount of tourists here, I have
to ensure
as many as possible remember
my name.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If I want to run in the likes of the
Takarazuka
Kinen or Arima Kinen, I need
fans to vote for
me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Logical, but still...

text_block_list.name: Tourist at Food Stall
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Is that the nepo baby everyone's
talking
about? Guess you can do
whatever you want
when you're rich.

text_block_list.name: Tourist in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text:
That's nepotism for you. I've heard her
mom was
seriously amazing, though. At
least, that's what
my dad says.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This approach seems counterproductive.
It would
be better to show off her actual
skills.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Such trifling criticism does nothing to
me.
Besides, I'm not going to give—

text_block_list.name: Tourists
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh! Is it who I think it is?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Sei! I finally found you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, if it isn't Spe! You running
from trouble
or what?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for a good fishing spot,
the
rocky area down by the coast should
be pretty
great.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not here for fishing. I wanted to
ask you
to go running with me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I keep thinking about how well you ran
in the
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Love that you get straight to the point.
Gives me
protagonist vibes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But, you're outta luck today! ☆ Why
show my
cards when I can just relax
instead?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: At least consider it for a second!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aw, come on!

text_block_list.name: Tourist at Food Stall
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really admire Special Week. She's
honest,
upfront, and super determined!

text_block_list.name: Tourist in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! And she's got such
good
judgment, observing Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Tourist in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text:
I'm expecting Seiun Sky to turn heads
too after
her performance in the Satsuki
Sho.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just one race and those two already
have
everyone calling them by their
names.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course. My name should be the talk
of the
town.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Instead, everyone keeps going on about "her daughter" and the like. The disrespect is just astonishing, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: K-Kawakami?! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What's with that question? I'm a student
at
Tracen Academy too. It's not weird for
me to be
at summer camp.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! That's not what I mean! You're
supposed to
be focused on your training!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! So, why don't you come with
me, King?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I heard you talking just now.
You
declared yourself the next winner of
the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I wanna train with strong people, the
kind who
are full of the confidence to
win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kawakami. You have much to learn.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kawakami. You have much to learn.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Umm... She's not younger... You see, sh—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Okay, King! I'm heading there first! I'm
gonna win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Win?! Against who?! I know you can't
mean me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Swept up by Kawakami Princess's
challenge, King
Halo joins her for a
running session.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh... How could you let this happen? Most everyone's already left.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, I do feel stronger after training, so
I'll let it
slide this time. But, starting from
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I'm glad you understand.
choice_data_list: 皆に“キングヘイロー”をアピールしよう

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going to take a stroll
before
heading back to the lodge. You
go on without
me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're going to make me have to deal
with her?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gulp... Heed the call from hell? Is that your secret training plan?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami... You aren't the sharpest tool
in the
shed, are you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What am I to do with you two?
Honestly...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right, then! If it's what you desire, I'll
grant you
the right to join me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your job is to shout "King Halo" after
everything I
say. Understand?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze... Well, I think that's about enough promotion for today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well done, everyone. Best to give your
voices a
break before tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! Once you've joined the
troop,
you should stick with it to the
very end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going to take a stroll
before
heading back to the lodge. You
go on without
me. ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fshhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I have a moment to respond, King
Halo
runs away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She dashes off a little slower than usual
because
of the sand, but nonetheless
swift.

text_block_list.name: Kind Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I knew it. She's different from her
mother.

text_block_list.name: Kind Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry. I guess I said that out loud.
You know, I
used to be a big fan of her
mother...

text_block_list.name: Kind Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I heard a rumor that her daughter would
be here,
so I couldn't help but come.
Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Kind Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She appears to have good form.
However, if it
were her mother...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Why am I already out of breath?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But I can't stop now—not until people

acknowledge me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The fame, the spotlight, the attention...
I'm
nowhere near where I want to be!
